name: Violet Plan ~Kansei no Reijo~
source:
Satomi works as a lecturer in a law school. She has a girlfriend among the students. Kazuki offers himself as a partner to Satomi, but is rejected, and his pride suffers greatly. Kazuki lays out numerous traps to insult and shame Satomi. After success, he delivers the same scheme for other girls. That plan gets a name "Violet plan".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
里美在法學院當講師，她的女朋友是學校的學生。和樹向里美求愛，被拒絕後自尊心大受打擊。他設下重重圈套，存心侮辱里美，讓她難堪。得手後，他又把同樣的手段用在其他女孩身上。這套計畫有了一個名字——「紫羅蘭計畫」。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
